faq.question: Is epipen (epinephrine auto-injector) allowed in carry-on bags?
faq.answer: EpiPen (Epinephrine Auto-Injector) is allowed in carry-on luggage. EpiPens are fully allowed in both carry-on and checked bags. Having them in the cabin is highly advised for emergency access.

faq.question: Can you pack epipen (epinephrine auto-injector) in checked baggage?
faq.answer: Yes, EpiPen (Epinephrine Auto-Injector) is allowed in checked bags.
